description: This file contains utility functions used within the SCSSPHP project, including range checking, URI encoding, and multibyte string handling wrappers.

classes.name: Util
classes.description: A collection of static utility functions for handling ranges, encoding, and multibyte string operations related to SCSS processing.

methods.name: checkRange
methods.description: Validates that a given value falls within a specified range, with a tolerance for floating-point errors, and throws an exception if not.

methods.name: encodeURIComponent
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion in a URI, escaping reserved characters.

methods.name: mbChr
methods.description: Returns a multibyte character for a given Unicode code point, with fallback support for environments lacking mb_chr.

methods.name: mbStrlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string in characters, supporting environments with or without mb_strlen.

methods.name: mbSubstr
methods.description: Returns a substring of a string based on character positions, with support for environments that lack mb_substr.

methods.name: mbStrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring in a string, in characters, with fallback support.
